import MumfordLib.AffineSimplexChainMaps
import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivision

/-!
# Naturality of barycentric subdivision under affine maps
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {m k n : ℕ}

theorem barycentricSubdivision_naturality
    (w : Fin (m + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 1))) (n : ℕ) :
    barycentricSubdivision m n ≫ (vertexListChainMap (affineSimplexMap w)).f n =
      (vertexListChainMap (affineSimplexMap w)).f n ≫ barycentricSubdivision k n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp [barycentricSubdivision]
  | succ n ih =>
      apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
      intro v
      dsimp only [vertexListSSet] at v
      change vertexListChain (fun i => v i) ≫ _ = vertexListChain (fun i => v i) ≫ _
      rw [vertexListChain_barycentricSubdivision_succ_assoc, vertexListChain_map_assoc,
        vertexListChain_barycentricSubdivision_succ]
      rw [vertexListCone_map, affineSimplexBarycenter_map]
      rw [← Category.assoc (barycentricSubdivision m n)
        ((vertexListChainMap (affineSimplexMap w)).f n)]
      rw [ih]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
      rw [← (vertexListChainMap (affineSimplexMap w)).comm_assoc]
      rw [vertexListChain_map_assoc]
      rfl

end Mumford.Analytic
